title: Casa Terraza - Phase III
shortDescription: 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5 BHK flats on Vasai West's 100 ft Road, every apartment with an attached terrace. RERA P99000031526, by TREC — 35+ landmarks, 5mn+ sq ft portfolio.
description: Casa Terraza Phase III is the final chapter of TREC's landmark Casa Terraza development on 100 ft Road, Vasai West. This 22-storey high-rise offers 1 to 5 BHK residences, each with its own attached terrace, designed for residents who value both indoor comfort and outdoor space. The project includes a dedicated 4-storey clubhouse with a gymnasium and indoor games room, along with a rooftop garden for relaxation and family time. Located near Sahakari Bhandar and well-connected to Vasai Road station, schools, and hospitals, Casa Terraza suits families looking for spacious, well-ventilated homes with strong social infrastructure nearby. Backed by TREC's three-decade legacy of over 35 completed projects across Mumbai, the development combines architectural quality with a trusted delivery track record.
fullDescription: Casa Terraza Phase III — 'Happiness Inside Out' — is a 22-storey single-tower residence on the 100 ft Road in Navghar, Vasai West, near the Sahakari Bhandar landmark. Every apartment features an attached terrace, with interiors finished to a premium specification of designer vitrified tiles, gypsum-finished walls, premium wall paint, designer bathrooms with premium CP fittings, parallel granite kitchen platforms, modular kitchen cabinets, AC in the living room, storage lofts and firefighting equipment. The project is built as a self-sufficient ecosystem with a 4-storey clubhouse, gymnasium, indoor games room, rooftop garden, kids play area, ample car parking, CCTV surveillance, power backup, rainwater harvesting, borewells and a sewage treatment plant. Developed by TREC — with 35+ completed landmarks and a 5mn+ sq ft portfolio across Mumbai — Casa Terraza Phase III is RERA registered (P99000031526) with an all-inclusive starting price of ₹60.74 Lacs.
